title: RESIDE ITS verified direct-overlap exposure quarantine
rationale: The archived local-geometric route verified 426 direct Haze4K-to-ITS source relationships but correctly withheld its exclusion output because it neither recovered a conjectured total of 500 relationships nor completed a valid ITS-to-ITS transitive closure. The exact total of 500 is a provenance expectation without an archived official relationship manifest, and approximate geometric similarity is not an equivalence relation. This route asks a narrower question aligned with the next measurement: can the 426 already verified direct relationships define explicit training-exposure and training-plus-selection-exposure quarantine tiers whose IDs all exist in the qualified official ITS copy and whose complements retain at least 6,000 clear scenes? It performs no new image matching, does not propagate ITS families, and never claims complete source disjointness.

scientific_contract.question: Do the 426 Haze4K-to-ITS relationships directly accepted by the frozen parent geometry rule yield exact training-exposure and training-plus-selection-exposure quarantine assets whose IDs all belong to the qualified official 11,000-scene ITS copy and whose complements retain at least 6,000 scenes?

intervention.reference: all 11,000 official ITS clear-scene identifiers and the exact archived 1,000-row parent relationship evidence
intervention.matched_budget: one deterministic metadata and official-ID membership census with no image decoding, image matching, model inference or family propagation
fixed_factors: only parent rows with accepted=True contribute IDs
HAZE4K_TRAIN rows define the training-exposure tier
the union of HAZE4K_TRAIN and HAZE4K_TEST rows defines the training-plus-selection-exposure tier
accepted ITS IDs remain split-qualified full identifiers such as ITS_TRAIN:id or ITS_VALIDATION:id
the parent evidence must contain exactly 302 accepted HAZE4K_TRAIN relationships and 124 accepted HAZE4K_TEST relationships
the training tier must contain exactly 1,653 unique ITS IDs and the union tier exactly 2,187 unique ITS IDs
all quarantined IDs must exist in the qualified official ITS copy
each tier must leave at least 6,000 official ITS clear scenes
no conjectured total source-relationship count is a gate
no rejected parent query is interpreted as evidence of absence
no ITS-to-ITS transitive family propagation is allowed
a PASS claims known verified overlap quarantine only, never complete Haze4K-ITS disjointness

primary_estimand.metric: number of official ITS clear-scene identifiers remaining after removing the union of direct IDs verified against Haze4K training and test or selection sources
primary_estimand.aggregation: deterministic set subtraction on split-qualified official ITS scene identifiers

controls: parent closeout, conclusion, summary and relationship table are exact SHA-256-bound inputs
the parent terminal remains a method-specific FAIL and is used only for its verified direct diagnostic rows
the qualified RESIDE archive hashes and exact 10,000 ITS-train plus 1,000 ITS-validation counts must reproduce
all 2,187 union IDs must occur exactly in the official ITS split-qualified ID set
the 1,653 training-tier IDs comprise exactly 1,498 ITS-train and 155 ITS-validation IDs
the 2,187 union IDs comprise exactly 2,032 ITS-train and 155 ITS-validation IDs
the Haze4K-train and Haze4K-test derived ID sets have zero intersection
non-PASS terminal states publish empty authorized exclusion files

uncertainty.method: deterministic full-population identifier census; no sampling uncertainty is asserted and the result does not estimate residual unidentified overlap

gates.estimand: parent closeout and conclusion identities and terminal tuple match
parent table contains 1,000 rows, 426 accepted relationships, 574 rejected relationships and 2,187 accepted candidate IDs
parent table contains 1,000 unique canonical group digests and Haze4K representatives
qualified RESIDE hashes and exact 10,000 ITS-train plus 1,000 ITS-validation clear scenes match
every accepted parent row names at least one unique accepted ITS ID and its best ID belongs to that set
relationship, exposure-tier, split and intersection counts equal the frozen 302, 124, 1,653, 534 and 2,187 values
proportion of union quarantine IDs present in the official split-qualified ITS identifier set
official ITS clear scenes remaining after training-exposure quarantine
official ITS clear scenes remaining after training-plus-selection-exposure quarantine

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: Additional Haze4K-to-ITS overlaps may remain among the 574 parent-unresolved groups, while some directly accepted IDs may be visually duplicated members rather than one privileged source filename. The assets therefore define conservative known-overlap quarantine populations and cannot support a claim of complete unseen-scene disjointness.
disabled_actions: new image matching or source relationship search
requiring or forcing exactly 500 Haze4K-to-ITS relationships
claiming that rejected parent queries prove absence of overlap
claiming complete Haze4K-ITS source disjointness or a sealed unseen test population
model selection, training, inference, dehazing evaluation or outcome metrics
measurement execution before a PASS closeout and a separately frozen measurement design

precision_contract.rationale: This operation deterministically transforms complete archived direct-relationship evidence into two identifier sets and verifies every ID against the full official ITS census; it estimates no sampled quantity or residual-overlap rate.

precision.estimand: official ITS clear-scene membership remaining after verified direct-overlap quarantine
precision.source_reference: All 11,000 official split-qualified ITS clear-scene identifiers are enumerated; the formal capacity gate uses the exact census count rather than a sample estimate.
